description: Tutorial lesson T3 driven with pad input: LB claims pad mode, cursor-glide + A through the picker, disembark via the middle unit-list row and dialog, 11 cursor-glide placement clicks, the boyz_move_after_disembark step driven in carry mode (A grab, glide, A drop) plus End This Unit's Move, RB to cycle to the Battlewagon, Advance radio + Confirm Movement Mode via glide+A, Keep Roll on the command re-roll, then a REAL carry for the wagon: B parks the cursor so A reaches PadRouter (with the cursor active, VirtualCursor eats A as a left-click and no carry ever starts), A grabs the wagon, glide + A drops it, A picks the same model straight back up for a second leg, LB twice turns it on the 'POINT IT RIGHT!' step, A drops it again and the two legs are asserted to SUM. Then End This Unit's Move and Start-button End Phase with its pad confirm. Native command re-roll and disembark dialogs are confirmed via emit_pressed (embedded-Window buttons have no reliable real-click coordinates).

steps.comment: PadRouter has no native disembark verb - the pad path is the virtual cursor clicking the row, which is exactly what click_item_list simulates (cursor warp + real click); glide-to-list-center lands on the empty strip below the rows
19.03: the attached Warboss disembarks WITH the Boyz — the pad placement asks for its base too (11 glide+A placements, not 10).
The Warboss model is actually on the board at a placed position
the wagon has not moved, so 18.04 leaves the disembarked Boyz selected for their own move - the new step teaches it

Same player report as the mouse variant: beginning the disembarked Boyz' move must not paint one cyan 2" coherency ring per model. Checked on the pad path too because the pad carry LIFTS the reach ring (dash.z_index = 50), so a re-introduced coherency ring would be even louder here.

B parks the virtual cursor left active by the placement clicks. While the cursor is live it swallows A as a raw left-click (press+release on the spot = a zero-distance stage, not a move), so the real pad carry flow is unreachable until it is parked.
A with the cursor parked opens the PadActionBar move menu (PadRouter._try_open_move_menu)
A on the 'Move' chip picks NORMAL and PadRouter._auto_carry_after_menu lifts the first Boy into carry mode
the model is genuinely in hand (cursor warped onto it with LMB held) - not a click
A drops him 40px (1") forward
the Boy really moved - the drop staged a non-zero distance (staged moves only reach GameState on CONFIRM_UNIT_MOVE, so this reads the live move data)
staging a model must NOT advance the step - it waits for the move to be locked in
confirming the move wrote the new position through to GameState
one RB tap exercises bumper cycling; selection lands on whichever unit is next in the post-disembark cycle order

steps.script:
var o = tree.root.get_node("/root/TutorialOverlay")
return o.current_body_text().contains("grab it again")
steps.comment: the card must actually SAY the move can be spent over several carries - players were treating the first drop as the whole move

B parks the virtual cursor. This is load-bearing, not tidying: while the cursor is ACTIVE, VirtualCursor._input eats A and re-emits it as a left-click at the cursor, so A never reaches PadRouter and no carry ever begins - it press-and-releases a mouse drag in place and stages a 0.0-inch move. Parked, A routes to PadRouter._handle_a -> _try_begin_carry. Same B-then-A opening as pad_group_move_all / pad_move_dpad_model_select.
A with the cursor parked and the move mode already locked: pad_menu_options() is empty (mode resolved), so _try_open_move_menu declines and A falls through to _try_begin_carry
steer the carried wagon - the glide drives the same cursor pipeline the left stick does, and the model rides the held synthetic LMB
A drops it. First hop only - deliberately a fraction of the 11 inch advance
the first hop is 40x40 board px = 1.41in of an 11in advance, so most of the move is still in hand for the second leg below

the pad body must name the bumpers - {lb}/{rb} render through PadBindingManager.display_glyph, the same role lookup PadRouter routes the press through, so a remapped pad keeps prompt and behaviour in step
the wagon enters the step un-rotated

A picks the SAME model straight back up - _drop_carry parked the cursor for exactly this, and PadRouter keeps carry_model_index so a drop is a waypoint, not a hand-off. This is the second leg the previous step's wording promises
LB/RB only rotate while a carry is live - otherwise PadRouter routes the bumpers to _cycle() (switch unit), so this guards the rotation assertion below from passing for the wrong reason
LB while carrying -> PadRouter._synth_rotate(true) -> the bound rotate_left key event -> MovementController rotates 15 degrees left

steps.script:
var u = GameState.get_unit("U_BATTLEWAGON_T")
return abs(float(u.models[0].get("rotation", 0.0)) + PI / 6.0) < 0.01
steps.comment: two LB taps = -2 * PI/12 = -PI/6 rad (-30 degrees), the same 15-degrees-a-tap the keyboard prompt promises
drop the second leg
multi-step movement proven on the pad too: 1.41in + 1.0in reads back as ~2.4in, so the second carry ADDED to the first instead of replacing it (a replace would still read 1.41in)
